title: Diane Powell meets Akil after his mother saw her interviewed by Deepak Chopra
summary: Diane Powell tells of Diane Powell meets Akil after his mother saw her interviewed by Deepak Chopra, about before c. 2022 at New Jersey, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

plain: On a 2025 episode of a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, about children said to be able to read minds, a woman named Diane Powell tells how she came to meet a boy named Akil in New Jersey around 2022. She says Akil's mother contacted her after seeing her interviewed by the well-known author Deepak Chopra. It is part of her account of how she came to study children who, if the claims are true, can share thoughts without speaking.
